description: Request a signed statement for a hash (sit-statement/0.1): creates an unlisted hash-only receipt via createMoment. First one free, no account. Once Bitcoin confirms the hash, the result carries statement: {v,sha256,status:"confirmed",block_height,block_hash,ots_sha256,issued_at,issuer,kid,sig}. While pending it returns statement: null and a wait note: pending is not a statement. Not an evaluation tool. No file upload. May be 429; no retry. Need more than the free rate? See https://soulintime.com/pricing.
name: stamp
